title: Amina — Nouvelle dans la ville
style: Modern stylized 3D animation, warm color palette, soft cinematic lighting, expressive character, high quality render

character.name: Amina
character.description: Amina, a 28-year-old North African woman, dark hair in a low bun, soft features, smart casual style with a camel coat and white sneakers, bright but lonely eyes

scenes.vo: Il y a huit mois, Amina a tout quitté pour son nouveau poste. Nouvelle ville. Nouveau bureau. Nouvelle vie.
scenes.image_prompt: Amina pulling a suitcase out of a train station into a big unfamiliar city, tall Haussmann buildings, golden afternoon light, small figure in a large frame
scenes.motion_prompt: She walks forward with her suitcase, the camera slowly pulls up revealing the vast city around her small figure

scenes.vo: Le travail, ça va. C'est le reste qui manque.
scenes.image_prompt: Amina at a modern office smiling professionally in a meeting, competent and appreciated, bright office light
scenes.motion_prompt: She presents confidently in the meeting, colleagues nod, subtle steady camera

scenes.vo: Le week-end : courses. Ménage. Écrans. Et le silence d'un appartement qu'elle connaît par cœur.
scenes.image_prompt: Sunday montage mood: Amina alone on her sofa wrapped in a blanket with her phone, tidy small apartment, grey light through the window, muted colors
scenes.motion_prompt: She scrolls slowly, pulls the blanket closer, the grey light barely changes, stillness

scenes.vo: Sa mère l'appelle. « Tu as rencontré des gens ? » Amina répond que oui. Elle ment un peu.
scenes.image_prompt: Amina on a video call with her worried loving mother on the phone screen, Amina forcing a reassuring smile, warm phone light in the dim room
scenes.motion_prompt: The mother speaks warmly on screen, Amina nods with a forced smile that fades when she hangs up

scenes.vo: Un soir, elle tombe sur Nour Meet. Des dîners en petit comité, près de chez elle. Des gens vérifiés. Des gens comme elle.
scenes.image_prompt: Amina's face lighting up looking at her phone showing a cozy dinner event card in a clean app interface, warm golden glow replacing the grey light
scenes.motion_prompt: Warm golden light spreads across her face and the room, she sits up, hope in her eyes

scenes.vo: Première soirée. Une table. Des rires. Des prénoms qu'elle retient.
scenes.image_prompt: A warm restaurant table with Amina laughing among a small friendly group, mint tea and shared plates, genuine connection, candlelight
scenes.motion_prompt: Laughter ripples around the table, candle flames dance, gentle lateral camera drift

scenes.vo: Aujourd'hui, ses week-ends ont des visages. Et l'un d'eux compte un peu plus que les autres.
scenes.image_prompt: Amina walking in a sunny Parisian park with new friends, and slightly apart a kind man walking beside her, both smiling shyly, vibrant warm colors
scenes.motion_prompt: The group walks and laughs, slow focus shift to Amina and the man exchanging a shy smile

scenes.vo: Une nouvelle ville, ce n'est pas une punition. C'est un début. Nour Meet. Inscris-toi gratuitement.
